notes.title: Yet another update!
notes.content:
And...another update. 2 small fixes.

1. Sound effects are now preloaded on start, this means that there's a large performance boost on slower PC's but the loading bar is back, a lot faster than the first build though.

2.The steam overlay is working again.

notes.title: Major update (NW.exe fix and loading time massivly reduced)
notes.content:
OK, biggest update so far. 3 huge fixes.

1. Fixed the nw.exe error (as far as I can tell)
2. Reduced RAM usage by a lot
3. Reduced intial load tim by 99%, most people shouldn't even get a loading bar now.

Let me know if you have any problems, thanks so much for your ongoing support.
